hints: The first digit of 235 is the hundreds.
Add 2 hundreds, then 3 tens.
Finish with 5 ones.
items.explanation: 235 is 2 hundreds, 3 tens and 5 ones, because 200, 30 and 5 make 235.

hints: Look at the digit in the tens place.
There are no tens in 408.
Use 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones.
items.explanation: 408 is 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones. The zero means no tens.

items.prompt: You have 23 tens. Trade until the number is shown with the fewest blocks.
hints: How many tens make one hundred?
Trade 10 tens for 1 hundred two times.
3 tens are left over.
items.explanation: 23 tens is 230. Two groups of 10 tens become 2 hundreds, and 3 tens are left.

items.prompt: Show 300 as 2 hundreds and 10 tens by breaking a hundred.
hints: A hundred can break into 10 tens.
Tap Break 1 into 10 tens in the hundreds column.
You should have 2 hundreds and 10 tens.
items.explanation: One hundred breaks into 10 tens, so 300 is the same as 2 hundreds and 10 tens.

hints: Give up one of the 5 hundreds.
Break 1 hundred into 10 tens.
You will have 16 tens in all.
items.explanation: Breaking 1 hundred gives 10 more tens. So 560 is 4 hundreds and 16 tens.

items.prompt: Start with 274. Add 58, then trade so the answer uses the fewest blocks.
hints: Add 5 tens and 8 ones.
You will have 12 ones and 12 tens. Trade ones first, then tens.
The answer is 3 hundreds, 3 tens and 2 ones.
items.explanation: 274 plus 58 is 332. After adding there are 12 tens and 12 ones. Trading gives 3 hundreds, 3 tens and 2 ones.

items.prompt: Start with 412. Take away 27 by breaking blocks when you need to.
hints: You cannot take 7 ones from 2 ones yet.
Break a ten into ones, then break a hundred into tens.
The answer has 3 hundreds, 8 tens and 5 ones.
items.explanation: 412 minus 27 is 385. Breaking a ten and then a hundred gives enough ones and tens to take away.
